policy: Include both complete campaigns with equal weight; retain all measured repeats.
Each p50/p95/p99 is the arithmetic mean of the two campaign percentiles, not a percentile of pooled frames.
Each paired ratio is the arithmetic mean of the two campaign geometric means of per-repeat candidate/baseline p95 ratios. Savings equal 100*(1-mean ratio).
DDA and headline LightTrace milliseconds remain from their DDA pair; Hi-Z milliseconds remain from its separate pair. Ratios never divide unrelated headline times.
Confidence intervals remain per campaign. No averaged or pooled confidence interval is claimed.
Ablation averages the two campaign equal-scene geometric-mean ratios with equal campaign weight.
Initialization averages corresponding counting-pass CPU-build and mapped-upload observations, excluding depth preparation and device/pipeline creation.
Identical input queries are replayed, not counted as additional unique queries. Deterministic counts and outputs remain unchanged.
